Trigger.name: Friends
Trigger.script:
local name = matches[2] local line = getCurrentLine() local start = line:find(name, 1, true)
if start then local mudletStart = start - 1
for i = 1, #name do local color
if i % 5 == 1 then color = {255, 120, 200} -- bright rose-pink elseif i % 5 == 2 then color = {220, 90, 255} -- magenta-purple elseif i % 5 == 3 then color = {255, 170, 215} -- soft pink elseif i % 5 == 4 then color = {190, 130, 255} -- lavender else color = {255, 185, 150} -- warm peach highlight end
selectSection(mudletStart + i - 1, 1) setFgColor(color[1], color[2], color[3]) end
resetFormat() deselect() end

Trigger.name: Royalty
Trigger.script:
local title = matches[2] local line = getCurrentLine() local start = line:find(title, 1, true)
if start then local mudletStart = start - 1 local len = #title
-- Royal purple -> gold --local primary = {105, 40, 210} --local secondary = {255, 220, 45} --local primary = {180, 20, 40} --local secondary = {230, 180, 70} local primary = {80, 90, 220} local secondary = {245, 215, 120} --local primary = {155, 70, 255} --local secondary = {255, 215, 65}
for i = 1, len do local ratio = 0
if len > 1 then ratio = (i - 1) / (len - 1) end
local r = math.floor(primary[1] + (secondary[1] - primary[1]) * ratio) local g = math.floor(primary[2] + (secondary[2] - primary[2]) * ratio) local b = math.floor(primary[3] + (secondary[3] - primary[3]) * ratio)
selectSection(mudletStart + i - 1, 1) setFgColor(r, g, b) end
resetFormat() deselect() end

Trigger.name: Military
Politics
Trigger.script:
local title = matches[2] local line = getCurrentLine() local start = line:find(title, 1, true)
if start then local mudletStart = start - 1 local len = #title
-- Religious alignment gradient: -- Good white -> Neutral red -> Evil dark grey local good = {195, 195, 0}--{255, 255, 255} local neutral = {220, 98, 76}--{220, 35, 35} local evil = {65, 65, 65}
for i = 1, len do local ratio = 0
if len > 1 then ratio = (i - 1) / (len - 1) end
local r, g, b
if ratio <= 0.5 then -- first half: white -> red local subratio = ratio / 0.5
r = math.floor(good[1] + (neutral[1] - good[1]) * subratio) g = math.floor(good[2] + (neutral[2] - good[2]) * subratio) b = math.floor(good[3] + (neutral[3] - good[3]) * subratio) else -- second half: red -> dark grey local subratio = (ratio - 0.5) / 0.5
r = math.floor(neutral[1] + (evil[1] - neutral[1]) * subratio) g = math.floor(neutral[2] + (evil[2] - neutral[2]) * subratio) b = math.floor(neutral[3] + (evil[3] - neutral[3]) * subratio) end
selectSection(mudletStart + i - 1, 1) setFgColor(r, g, b) end
resetFormat() deselect() end

local title = matches[2] local line = getCurrentLine() local start = line:find(title, 1, true)
if start then local mudletStart = start - 1 local len = #title
-- Emerald civic green -> parchment gold local primary = {44, 73, 200} local secondary = {235, 205, 120}
for i = 1, len do local ratio = 0
if len > 1 then ratio = (i - 1) / (len - 1) end
local r = math.floor(primary[1] + (secondary[1] - primary[1]) * ratio) local g = math.floor(primary[2] + (secondary[2] - primary[2]) * ratio) local b = math.floor(primary[3] + (secondary[3] - primary[3]) * ratio)
selectSection(mudletStart + i - 1, 1) setFgColor(r, g, b) end
resetFormat() deselect() end

Trigger.name: Scholarly
Religious
Trigger.script:
local title = matches[2] local line = getCurrentLine() local start = line:find(title, 1, true)
if start then local mudletStart = start - 1 local len = #title
-- Religious alignment gradient: -- Good white -> Neutral red -> Evil dark grey local good = {255, 255, 255} local neutral = {220, 35, 35} local evil = {65, 65, 65}
for i = 1, len do local ratio = 0
if len > 1 then ratio = (i - 1) / (len - 1) end
local r, g, b
if ratio <= 0.5 then -- first half: white -> red local subratio = ratio / 0.5
r = math.floor(good[1] + (neutral[1] - good[1]) * subratio) g = math.floor(good[2] + (neutral[2] - good[2]) * subratio) b = math.floor(good[3] + (neutral[3] - good[3]) * subratio) else -- second half: red -> dark grey local subratio = (ratio - 0.5) / 0.5
r = math.floor(neutral[1] + (evil[1] - neutral[1]) * subratio) g = math.floor(neutral[2] + (evil[2] - neutral[2]) * subratio) b = math.floor(neutral[3] + (evil[3] - neutral[3]) * subratio) end
selectSection(mudletStart + i - 1, 1) setFgColor(r, g, b) end
resetFormat() deselect() end

Trigger.name: Conclave
Trigger.script:
local name = matches[2] local line = getCurrentLine() local start = line:find(name, 1, true)
if start then local mudletStart = start - 1 local len = #name
-- Conclave mystical palette: -- edges = dark robe/shadow -- inner = crimson robe energy -- center = white arcane glow local edge = {55, 55, 65} -- black robes / dark grey local inner = {210, 35, 35} -- red robes / crimson local center = {255, 255, 255} -- white robes / arcane core
local midpoint = (len + 1) / 2 local maxDist = midpoint - 1
for i = 1, len do local dist = math.abs(i - midpoint) local ratio = 0
if maxDist > 0 then ratio = dist / maxDist end
local r, g, b
if ratio <= 0.5 then -- center -> inner red local subratio = ratio / 0.5
r = math.floor(center[1] + (inner[1] - center[1]) * subratio) g = math.floor(center[2] + (inner[2] - center[2]) * subratio) b = math.floor(center[3] + (inner[3] - center[3]) * subratio) else -- inner red -> dark edge local subratio = (ratio - 0.5) / 0.5
r = math.floor(inner[1] + (edge[1] - inner[1]) * subratio) g = math.floor(inner[2] + (edge[2] - inner[2]) * subratio) b = math.floor(inner[3] + (edge[3] - inner[3]) * subratio) end
selectSection(mudletStart + i - 1, 1) setFgColor(r, g, b) end
resetFormat() deselect() end
